guitar.evidence: Dio's guitarists (Vivian Campbell on Holy Diver/Last in Line era, later Craig Goldy) commonly used Jackson/Charvel-style superstrats typical of early-80s metal, but no single guitar is iconic enough for higher confidence.

tone.target: singing high-gain metal crunch with mid punch
tone.profile: singing high-gain metal crunch with mid punch
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing an OD boost for aggressive attack, followed by a powerful Marshall-style amp and 4x12 cabinet to achieve singing, punchy lead tones suitable for Dio's style.

rig.name: Dio - The Last In Line - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Provide aggressive attack and sustain boost for lead lines.
blocks.gap: The Boost model is used to simulate a dedicated overdrive pedal (like an OD 9 or Green OD) without adding excessive grit, focusing purely on punch and volume lift.

alternatives.reason: If more harmonic distortion was desired.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain metal crunch tone and sustain.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen for its versatility in achieving modern, tight high gain without sounding overly scooped or fuzzy.

alternatives.reason: If a more aggressive, mid-focused crunch was needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi sound required for powerful rock leads and punchy mids.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP is ideal for high-gain, articulate lead tones while maintaining a vintage British crunch character.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more aggressive, raw tone was desired.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary physical cabinet tone and punchy midrange character.
blocks.gap: None. This is the standard choice for classic rock/metal tones.

blocks.purpose: Boost the upper-mids and overall midrange punch to cut through a mix (addressing 'add more midrange').
blocks.gap: None. Used specifically for surgical tone shaping.

blocks.purpose: Included as a subtle option for thickening the tone if needed, but kept inactive to avoid unwanted effects (as per 'avoid' list).
blocks.gap: The Chorus is generally avoided, so this module serves primarily as an optional placeholder. It is set to low depth/rate.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space for soloing without distracting from the main riff.
blocks.gap: None. Used sparingly to enhance lead lines.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation to provide more natural, articulate midrange punch for lead tones.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper-mid bite and articulation for Dio's singing leads.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in the mids.
